newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela names new defense minister.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela names new defense minister.

text.p: President Rafael Caldera on Friday named Vice Admiral Tito Manglio Rincon Bravo as Venezuela's new defence minister.
Rincon, who held the post of Armed Forces General Inspector, will take over when outgoing Minister Gen. Pedro Nicolas Valencia Vivas retires on July 1.
The armed forces are one of the most respected institutions in a country tainted by high levels of corruption.
Relations with the government have markedly improved under Caldera, who pardoned more than 100 officers who took part in two 1992 coup attempts against the previous administration.
Rincon will be the fourth defence minister since Caldera took office in February 1994. Officers are usually nominated to the post in the last year of service before retirement.
